name: MetaOptimizerPage

states.name: Page Layout & Structure
states.description: The MetaOptimizerPage renders a horizontal tab bar at the top and a scrollable content area below. The tab bar contains 14 tabs. The page fills the full height of its container.

states.name: Tab Navigation
states.description: Clicking any tab button switches the visible content panel. Only one tab's content is rendered at a time.

states.name: Duel Pools — Layout & Empty State
states.description: The DuelPoolsTab has a two-panel layout: a fixed-width (w-80) pool list sidebar on the left and a flexible detail panel on the right. On initial load it fetches pools from GET /meta-optimizer/duel-pools.

states.name: Duel Pools — Pool List & Detail
states.description: When pools exist, the sidebar lists them with status badges, agent type, generation, and timestamps. Clicking a pool loads its candidates in the detail panel with a Copeland ranking table.
states.precondition: Duel Pools tab is selected and at least one pool exists

states.name: Duel Pools — Duel Results
states.description: The duel results section shows pairwise comparison outcomes. Loaded on demand via a 'Show Duel Results' button.

states.name: Duel Pools — Copeland Ranking Correctness
states.description: The Copeland ranking displayed in the candidates table must correctly reflect pairwise dominance. This validates the duel engine's ranking algorithm output as displayed on the page.
states.precondition: A pool is selected with 2+ candidates

states.name: Beam Runs — Layout & Empty State
states.description: The BeamRunsTab has the same two-panel layout as DuelPoolsTab: fixed-width sidebar with runs list, flexible detail panel showing candidates grouped by generation.

states.name: Beam Runs — Run List & Candidates
states.description: Run list shows status, agent_type, generation. Selecting a run loads candidates grouped by generation with expandable cards showing critique, changes, and prompt content.
states.precondition: Beam Runs tab is selected and runs exist

states.name: Span Events — Filter Controls
states.description: The SpanEventsTab has filter inputs for execution_id and agent_type, plus a Load button. Events are fetched on demand (not on mount).

states.name: Span Events — Event Display & Grouping
states.description: Loaded events are grouped by execution_id with collapsible sections. Each group shows an event table with type-specific detail rendering.

states.name: Visual Design — Dark Theme Compliance
states.description: All three new tabs follow the runner's dark zinc theme. Background colors, text colors, borders, and interactive states must be consistent with the existing meta-optimizer tabs.
states.precondition: Any of the three new tabs is selected

states.name: API Integration & Data Flow
states.description: All three tabs fetch data from the runner's HTTP API. API failures should not crash the UI.

states.name: Accessibility
states.description: Interactive elements have proper ARIA roles, tabIndex, and keyboard event handlers for accessibility.
states.precondition: Any tab with interactive list items

description: Meta-Optimizer Page — The central dashboard for the prompt optimization pipeline. Contains 14 sub-tabs covering progress tracking, recommendations, prompt optimization via beam search + dueling bandits, canary A/B testing, eval specs, and adaptive learning. The three new tabs (Duel Pools, Beam Runs, Span Events) display data from the agent-lightning + prompt-ops integration: beam search candidate generation, pairwise duel evaluation with Copeland ranking, and granular span-level execution instrumentation.
